$comment: Curated source list. scripts/build.mjs turns this into site/index.json (official market index format 1) and validates it with @deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index. Only packages that declare a dsh.bundle are installable entries; anything else belongs in a feed, not here.

description.zh: 人工筛选并逐条校验的 DeepSeek Harness 插件索引：每个条目都确认过 npm 上存在、声明了 dsh.bundle、并给出可安装的精确版本。
description.en: A hand-picked, individually verified index of DeepSeek Harness plugins: every entry is confirmed to exist on npm, declare a dsh.bundle, and list exact installable versions.

description.zh: 诊断插件安装、兼容性与实际加载问题，给出可预览的修复方案与可回滚的启动试验。
description.en: Diagnoses plugin installation, compatibility and loading problems, with repair previews and reversible startup trials.

description.zh: 面向插件开发的运行时诊断与就地修复：让 agent 自己跑一遍就能定位问题。
description.en: Runtime diagnostics and in-place fixes for plugin development that the agent can run itself.

description.zh: 设置页里的健康面板：扫描插件、逐行展示状态，并附带一个诊断对话入口。
description.en: A settings-page health panel that scans plugins, lists each row's state and adds a diagnosis chat.

description.zh: 在插件页直接升级插件，支持版本历史、回滚与实时 pnpm 进度。
description.en: Upgrade plugins from the Plugins page, with version history, rollback and live pnpm progress.

description.zh: 把一组插件打包成短码离线分享，对方粘贴即可复刻同一套插件。
description.en: Share a plugin set offline as a compact code that reproduces the same set on another machine.

description.zh: 在 macOS 与 Windows 上截取当前窗口上下文，直接交给 agent 看。
description.en: Capture the current window as context for the agent on macOS and Windows.

description.zh: 社区写的插件质量指南：ENTRY、FLOW 检查与改进建议。非官方、非认证。
description.en: A community guide to plugin quality: ENTRY checks, FLOW checks and improvement hints. Not official, not a certification.

description.zh: 社区插件市场客户端，按官方插件规范浏览、搜索并安装社区插件。
description.en: A community marketplace client that browses, searches and installs community plugins to the official spec.

description.zh: 免登录、免 Key 即可使用多种前沿模型的模型侧插件（上游行为由维护者决定，请自行评估）。
description.en: A model-side plugin that adds frontier models without sign-in or API keys (upstream behaviour is the maintainer's call — judge for yourself).
